title: Operations reports
subtitle: Status mix, throughput, aged backlog, and SLA. Filters apply to all charts.
status_dist_subtitle: Snapshot of all tickets in scope. Not affected by date range.
manager_throughput_subtitle: In the selected date range. Includes Building Managers and Company Admins with at least one assignment in scope.
age_buckets_subtitle: Open = not yet {{approved}} or {{rejected}}. Includes {{waiting}} and {{reopened}}.
age_buckets_empty: No open tickets in this scope.
sla_dist_subtitle: Snapshot of all tickets in scope by SLA state. Not affected by date range.
sla_breach_subtitle: share of tickets created in each bucket that ever breached
tickets_by_type_subtitle: Number of tickets created in the selected range, grouped by type.
tickets_by_origin_subtitle: Tickets created in the selected range, grouped by how they originated: normal, extra work, converted, or planned.
ew_revenue_subtitle: Billable value of Extra Work requested in the selected range, grouped by revenue state. Earned = the spawned ticket is closed; in progress = spawned but not yet closed.
ew_revenue_empty: No Extra Work in this range.
ew_revenue_by_building_subtitle: This customer's billable Extra Work revenue, split across their buildings.
ew_revenue_by_building_empty: No Extra Work revenue in this range.
ew_by_department_subtitle: This customer's billable Extra Work, grouped by building, department and work type.
ew_by_department_empty: No Extra Work in this range.
ew_by_building_subtitle: Extra Work-origin tickets only, grouped by building in the selected range.
ew_by_customer_subtitle: Extra Work-origin tickets only, grouped by customer location in the selected range.
tickets_by_customer_subtitle: Tickets per customer location. Customers with the same name at different buildings are kept distinct.
tickets_by_building_subtitle: Tickets per building in the selected date range.
hours_comparison.title: Contracted hours vs worked hours
hours_comparison.subtitle: Per building: what was agreed, what was worked, and the difference.
hours_comparison.empty: No contracted and no worked hours in this month.
hours_comparison.asymmetry_note: A contract fixes hours per BUILDING, not per worker. The per-worker breakdown below is therefore WORKED hours only; there is no agreed figure per person.
hours_comparison.folded: {{count}} building(s) folded into Other; the table shows them all.
worker_hours.title: Worker hour report
worker_hours.subtitle: Per week, worker, building and hour type — with Monday to Sunday.
worker_hours.card_hint: Open for the table, the week tabs and the Excel or PDF export.
worker_hours.missing_columns: The reference report also shows personnel number, contract hours, cost centre and code, order number, place, action, debtor, authorisation, hour code and travel costs. We hold none of that data; it is deliberately not shown here as an empty column.
